fields.title: Input column
fields.description: The String or XML column containing valid SVG text (or XML).
fields.choicesError: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0

fields.title: Output column
fields.description: Choose whether to replace the selected input column with the SVG data, or to append a new column containing the SVG objects.

fields.title: New column name
fields.description: Name of the new column appended to the input table containing the converted SVG images. Only applicable when "Append new column" is selected.

fields.title: Fail on invalid input cell
fields.description: If selected, the node will fail during execution if any cell contains invalid SVG image data. If unselected, the node will skip these invalid entries and insert a missing value instead.
